integrity: The symbolic facet proof applies to the entire closed parameter interval. Checker experiments use finitely many exact rational parameters and are supplementary. No independent review performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform truncations of regular three-dimensional tetrahedra only; no claims for irregular tetrahedra, anisotropic truncations, or higher-dimensional simplices. Literature coverage may miss prior equivalent formulations.
title: A unique zonotopal difference body and a sharp width transition in tetrahedral truncations
